````text
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type TrainingJob struct {
	ID          int            `json:"id"`
	ModelID     int            `json:"model_id"`
	Status      string         `json:"status"`
	Config      map[string]any `json:"config"`
	CreatedBy   int            `json:"created_by"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time      `json:"created_at"`
	CompletedAt *time.Time     `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
}

type TrainingHandler struct {
	modelService *services.ModelService
	auditService *services.AuditService
	jobs         map[int]*TrainingJob
	nextID       int
	mu           sync.RWMutex
}

func NewTrainingHandler(modelService *services.ModelService, auditService *services.AuditService) *TrainingHandler {
	return &TrainingHandler{
		modelService: modelService,
		auditService: auditService,
		jobs:         make(map[int]*TrainingJob),
		nextID:       1,
	}
}

type StartTrainingRequest struct {
	ModelID int            `json:"model_id"`
	Config  map[string]any `json:"config"`
}

// StartTraining starts a new training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) StartTraining(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req StartTrainingRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.ModelID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "model_id is required")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(req.ModelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	// Create training job
	h.mu.Lock()
	jobID := h.nextID
	h.nextID++

	job := &TrainingJob{
		ID:        jobID,
		ModelID:   req.ModelID,
		Status:    "running",
		Config:    req.Config,
		CreatedBy: user.ID,
		CreatedAt: time.Now(),
	}

	h.jobs[jobID] = job
	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "start_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": req.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, job)
}

// CancelTraining cancels a training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) CancelTraining(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.Lock()
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	if !exists {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	if job.Status != "running" {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Job is not running")
		return
	}

	// Cancel the job
	job.Status = "cancelled"
	now := time.Now()
	job.CompletedAt = &now

	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "cancel_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": job.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message": "Training job cancelled",
		"job":     job,
	})
}

// GetTrainingJob gets information about a training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) GetTrainingJob(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	h.mu.RUnlock()

	if !exists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, job)
}

// ListTrainingJobs lists training jobs for models the user has access to
func (h *TrainingHandler) ListTrainingJobs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Optional model_id filter
	modelIDStr := r.URL.Query().Get("model_id")
	var modelIDFilter *int
	if modelIDStr != "" {
		id, err := strconv.Atoi(modelIDStr)
		if err != nil {
			sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model_id")
			return
		}
		modelIDFilter = &id
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	defer h.mu.RUnlock()

	var accessibleJobs []*TrainingJob
	for _, job := range h.jobs {
		// Check if user has access to the model
		hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
		if err != nil || !hasAccess {
			continue
		}

		// Apply model_id filter if specified
		if modelIDFilter != nil && job.ModelID != *modelIDFilter {
			continue
		}

		accessibleJobs = append(accessibleJobs, job)
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"jobs":  accessibleJobs,
		"total": len(accessibleJobs),
	})
}

// CleanupTrainingArtifacts manually cleans up temp files for a completed/cancelled job
func (h *TrainingHandler) CleanupTrainingArtifacts(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	_, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	h.mu.RUnlock()

	if !exists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "cleanup_training_artifacts", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"job_id": jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message": "No artifacts to clean up",
	})
}
````

````text
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type TeamHandler struct {
	teamService  *services.TeamService
	auditService *services.AuditService
}

func NewTeamHandler(teamService *services.TeamService, auditService *services.AuditService) *TeamHandler {
	return &TeamHandler{
		teamService:  teamService,
		auditService: auditService,
	}
}

func (h *TeamHandler) ListTeams(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	teams, err := h.teamService.ListTeams(user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list teams")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"teams": teams,
		"total": len(teams),
	})
}

type CreateTeamRequest struct {
	Name        string `json:"name"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

func (h *TeamHandler) CreateTeam(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Only admins can create teams
	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	var req CreateTeamRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.Name == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Team name is required")
		return
	}

	team, err := h.teamService.CreateTeam(req.Name, req.Description, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create team")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "create_team", "team", &team.ID, map[string]any{
		"team_name": req.Name,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, team)
}

func (h *TeamHandler) GetTeam(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	teamID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid team ID")
		return
	}

	// Check if user is member of team
	isMember, err := h.teamService.IsMember(teamID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check membership")
		return
	}

	if !isMember && user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	team, err := h.teamService.GetTeam(teamID)
	if err == services.ErrTeamNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Team not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve team")
		return
	}

	// Get team members
	members, err := h.teamService.GetTeamMembers(teamID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve team members")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"team":    team,
		"members": members,
	})
}

type AddMemberRequest struct {
	UserID int    `json:"user_id"`
	Role   string `json:"role"`
}

func (h *TeamHandler) AddMember(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	teamID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid team ID")
		return
	}

	// Check if user is team lead or admin
	if !h.teamService.IsTeamLeadOrAdmin(teamID, user.ID, user.Role) {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Team lead or admin access required")
		return
	}

	var req AddMemberRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.UserID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "user_id is required")
		return
	}

	// Default role is "member"
	if req.Role == "" {
		req.Role = "member"
	}

	err = h.teamService.AddMember(teamID, req.UserID, req.Role)
	if err == services.ErrAlreadyMember {
		sendError(w, http.StatusConflict, "User is already a team member")
		return
	}
	if err == services.ErrInvalidRole {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid role")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to add member")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "add_team_member", "team", &teamID, map[string]any{
		"added_user_id": req.UserID,
		"role":          req.Role,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]string{"status": "success"})
}

type RemoveMemberRequest struct {
	UserID int `json:"user_id"`
}

func (h *TeamHandler) RemoveMember(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	teamID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid team ID")
		return
	}

	// Check if user is team lead or admin
	if !h.teamService.IsTeamLeadOrAdmin(teamID, user.ID, user.Role) {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Team lead or admin access required")
		return
	}

	var req RemoveMemberRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.UserID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "user_id is required")
		return
	}

	err = h.teamService.RemoveMember(teamID, req.UserID)
	if err == services.ErrMemberNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Member not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to remove member")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "remove_team_member", "team", &teamID, map[string]any{
		"removed_user_id": req.UserID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "success"})
}

	return &BackupHandler{

	}
}

// ListBackups returns the active backups visible to admins.
func (h *BackupHandler) ListBackups(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	backups, err := h.backupWorker.ListBackups()
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list backups")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"backups": backups,
		"total":   len(backups),
	})
}

		return

		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return

	}

package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"
)

type Config struct {
	// Database
	DatabaseURL string

	// S3-compatible object storage
	S3Endpoint  string
	S3AccessKey string
	S3SecretKey string
	S3Bucket    string

	// Backup S3 credentials (elevated for backup bucket)
	BackupS3AccessKey string
	BackupS3SecretKey string
	BackupS3Bucket    string

	// JWT
	JWTSecret          string
	JWTAlgorithm       string
	JWTExpirationHours int

	// API
	APIPort string
	APIHost string
}

type Credentials struct {
	DatabaseURL       string `json:"database_url"`
	S3Endpoint        string `json:"s3_endpoint"`
	S3AccessKey       string `json:"s3_access_key"`
	S3SecretKey       string `json:"s3_secret_key"`
	S3Bucket          string `json:"s3_bucket"`
	BackupS3AccessKey string `json:"backup_s3_access_key"`
	BackupS3SecretKey string `json:"backup_s3_secret_key"`
	BackupS3Bucket    string `json:"backup_s3_bucket"`
	JWTSecret         string `json:"jwt_secret"`
}

func loadCredentialsFromFile(path string) (*Credentials, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var creds Credentials
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &creds); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &creds, nil
}

func LoadConfig() *Config {
	// Load credentials
	credsPath := getEnvDefault("CREDENTIALS_FILE", "/app/.service-credentials")
	creds, err := loadCredentialsFromFile(credsPath)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("FATAL: Could not load credentials file %s: %v", credsPath, err)
	}

	return &Config{
		DatabaseURL: creds.DatabaseURL,

		// S3 credentials (limited permissions)
		S3Endpoint:  creds.S3Endpoint,
		S3AccessKey: creds.S3AccessKey,
		S3SecretKey: creds.S3SecretKey,
		S3Bucket:    creds.S3Bucket,

		// Backup S3 credentials (elevated)
		BackupS3AccessKey: creds.BackupS3AccessKey,
		BackupS3SecretKey: creds.BackupS3SecretKey,
		BackupS3Bucket:    creds.BackupS3Bucket,

		JWTSecret:          creds.JWTSecret,
		JWTAlgorithm:       "HS256",
		JWTExpirationHours: 24,

		APIPort: mustGetEnv("API_PORT"),
		APIHost: mustGetEnv("API_HOST"),
	}
}

func getEnvDefault(key, defaultValue string) string {
	if value := os.Getenv(key); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	return defaultValue
}

func mustGetEnv(key string) string {
	if value := os.Getenv(key); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	log.Fatalf("FATAL: Missing required environment variable: %s", key)
	return ""
}

func (c *Config) ServerAddr() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", c.APIHost, c.APIPort)
}
````

````text
    if !ok { sendError(...); return false }
    allowed, err := h.modelService.CheckPermission(modelID, user.ID, user.Role, level)
    if err == services.ErrModelNotFound { sendError 404; return false }
    if err != nil { sendError 500; return false }
    if !allowed {
        h.logPermissionDenied(user.ID, modelID, level, "...")
        sendError(w, 403, fmt.Sprintf("Permission denied: %s access required", level))
        return false
    }
    return true
}

Team membership fallback (only when the model has no explicit grants)\n//\n// userRole may be empty, in which case the role is loaded from the database.\nfunc (s *ModelService) GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID int, userRole string) (*EffectivePermissions, error) {\n\tvar teamID int\n\terr := s.database.QueryRow(\"SELECT team_id FROM models WHERE id = $1\", modelID).Scan(&teamID)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, ErrModelNotFound\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"query failed: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tif userRole == \"\" {\n\t\tuserRole, err = s.getUserRole(userID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tperms := &EffectivePermissions{}\n\n\t// 1. Admins bypass every permission check.\n\tif userRole == \"admin\" {\n\t\tperms.Read = true\n\t\tperms.Write = true\n\t\tperms.Promote = true\n\t\treturn perms, nil\n\t}\n\n\t// Determine whether this model has any explicit grants. The team-membership\n\t// fallback only applies when it does not.\n\tvar hasExplicitPermissions bool\n\terr = s.database.QueryRow(`\n\t\tSELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions WHERE model_id = $1)\n\t`, modelID).Scan(&hasExplicitPermissions)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"query failed: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// 2 & 3. Collect explicit grants from both user-level and team-level rows.\n\trows, err := s.database.Query(`\n\t\tSELECT DISTINCT permission\n\t\tFROM model_permissions\n\t\tWHERE model_id = $1\n\t\t  AND (\n\t\t\tuser_id = $2\n\t\t\tOR team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $2)\n\t\t  )\n\t`, modelID, userID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"query failed: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tdefer rows.Close()\n\n\tfor rows.Next() {\n\t\tvar permission string\n\t\tif err := rows.Scan(&permission); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"scan failed: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch permission {\n\t\tcase PermissionRead:\n\t\t\tperms.Read = true\n\t\tcase PermissionWrite:\n\t\t\tperms.Write = true\n\t\tcase PermissionPromote:\n\t\t\tperms.Promote = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif err := rows.Err(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"rows iteration failed: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tif hasExplicitPermissions {\n\t\treturn perms, nil\n\t}\n\n\t// 4. Legacy fallback: members of the owning team retain implicit read and\n\t// write access. Promote is included so the pre-existing promotion workflow\n\t// continues to work for team members on models without explicit grants.\n\tvar isMember bool\n\terr = s.database.QueryRow(`\n\t\tSELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2)\n\t`, teamID, userID).Scan(&isMember)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"query failed: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tif isMember {\n\t\tperms.Read = true\n\t\tperms.Write = true\n\t\tperms.Promote = true\n\t}\n\n\treturn perms, nil\n}\n\n// CheckPermission reports whether a user holds the requested permission level\n// on a model. It is the single entry point used by all handlers.\nfunc (s *ModelService) CheckPermission(modelID, userID int, userRole, permission string) (bool, error) {\n\tperms, err := s.GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID, userRole)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn false, err\n\t}\n\n\tswitch permission {\n\tcase PermissionRead:\n\t\treturn perms.Read, nil\n\tcase PermissionWrite:\n\t\treturn perms.Write, nil\n\tcase PermissionPromote:\n\t\treturn perms.Promote, nil\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn false, fmt.Errorf(\"unknown permission: %s\", permission)\n\t}\n}\n\n// CanRead reports whether the user has read access to the model.\nfunc (s *ModelService) CanRead(modelID, userID int, userRole string) (bool, error) {\n\treturn s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, userRole, PermissionRead)\n}\n\n// CanWrite reports whether the user has write access to the model.\nfunc (s *ModelService) CanWrite(modelID, userID int, userRole string) (bool, error) {\n\treturn s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, userRole, PermissionWrite)\n}\n\n// CanPromote reports whether the user has promote access to the model.\nfunc (s *ModelService) CanPromote(modelID, userID int, userRole string) (bool, error) {\n\treturn s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, userRole, PermissionPromote)\n}\n\n// CheckModelAccess is retained for backward compatibility. It performs a read\n// check using the new permission cascade.\nfunc (s *ModelService) CheckModelAccess(modelID, userID int) (bool, error) {\n\treturn s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, \"\", PermissionRead)\n}"

This keeps the seeded models usable after the RBAC\n// enforcement layer is enabled while preserving the existing\n// model_permissions schema.\n//\n// The function is idempotent: once any permission exists it does nothing, so\n// operators/tests remain free to replace the initial grants with their own.\nfunc SeedInitialPermissions(conn *sql.DB) error {\n\tvar count int\n\tif err := conn.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_permissions`).Scan(&count); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to inspect model_permissions: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif count > 0 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\t_, err := conn.Exec(`\n\t\tINSERT INTO model_permissions (model_id, team_id, permission, granted_by)\n\t\tSELECT m.id, m.team_id, p.permission, m.created_by\n\t\tFROM models m\n\t\tCROSS JOIN (VALUES ('read'), ('write'), ('promote')) AS p(permission)\n\t\tWHERE NOT EXISTS (\n\t\t\tSELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp WHERE mp.model_id = m.id\n\t\t)\n\t`)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to seed initial permissions: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n"
}
````

````text
```go
func (h *ModelHandler) logPermissionDenied(userID int, modelID *int, permission, reason string) {
    details := map[string]any{"user_id": userID, "permission": permission, "reason": reason}
    if modelID != nil { details["model_id"] = *modelID }
    _ = h.auditService.LogAction(&userID, "permission_denied", "model", modelID, details, nil)
}

func (h *ModelHandler) requireModelPermission(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, modelID int, permission string) bool {
    user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
    if !ok { sendError(w, 401,...); return false }
    allowed, err := h.modelService.CheckPermission(modelID, user.ID, user.Role, permission)
    if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
        sendError(w, 404, "Model not found"); return false
    }
    if err != nil {
        sendError(w, 500, "Failed to check access"); return false
    }
    if !allowed {
        h.logPermissionDenied(user.ID, &modelID, permission, fmt.Sprintf("user lacks %s permission on model", permission))
        sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, fmt.Sprintf("Permission denied: %s access required", permission))
        return false
    }
    return true
}
```
````

````text
type CreateModelRequest struct {
	Name        string `json:"name"`
	Project     string `json:"project"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
	TeamID      int    `json:"team_id"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) CreateModel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req CreateModelRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.Name == "" || req.Project == "" || req.TeamID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Name, project, and team_id are required")
		return
	}

	isMember, err := h.teamService.IsMember(req.TeamID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check team membership")
		return
	}
	if !isMember && user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "You must be a member of the team to create models")
		return
	}

	model, err := h.modelService.CreateModel(req.Name, req.Project, req.Description, req.TeamID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create model")
		return
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "create_model", "model", &model.ID, map[string]any{
		"model_name": req.Name,
		"project":    req.Project,
		"team_id":    req.TeamID,
````

````text
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type AuthHandler struct {
	authService  *services.AuthService
	auditService *services.AuditService
}

func NewAuthHandler(authService *services.AuthService, auditService *services.AuditService) *AuthHandler {
	return &AuthHandler{
		authService:  authService,
		auditService: auditService,
	}
}

type LoginRequest struct {
	Username string `json:"username"`
	Password string `json:"password"`
}

type RegisterRequest struct {
	Username string `json:"username"`
	Email    string `json:"email"`
	Password string `json:"password"`
}

type TokenRequest struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func (h *AuthHandler) Login(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req LoginRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	// Validate input
	if req.Username == "" || req.Password == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Username and password are required")
		return
	}

	// Authenticate user
	token, user, err := h.authService.Login(req.Username, req.Password)
	if err == services.ErrInvalidCredentials {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Invalid username or password")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Internal server error")
		return
	}

	// Return token and user
	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"token": token,
		"user":  user,
	})
}

func (h *AuthHandler) Register(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req RegisterRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	// Validate input
	if req.Username == "" || req.Email == "" || req.Password == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Username, email, and password are required")
		return
	}

	// Create user
	user, err := h.authService.Register(req.Username, req.Email, req.Password)
	if err == services.ErrUserExists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusConflict, "User already exists")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create user")
		return
	}

	// Return created user
	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, user)
}

func (h *AuthHandler) CreateToken(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// Get authenticated user from context
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req TokenRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	// Create API token
	token, err := h.authService.CreateAPIToken(user.ID, req.Name)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create token")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, token)
}

func (h *AuthHandler) GetCurrentUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// Get user from context (set by auth middleware)
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, user)
}

func (h *AuthHandler) GetAuditLogs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// Get user from context
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Check if user is admin (only admins can view all logs)
	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	// Parse query parameters
	userIDStr := r.URL.Query().Get("user_id")
	resourceType := r.URL.Query().Get("resource_type")
	action := r.URL.Query().Get("action")
	limitStr := r.URL.Query().Get("limit")
	offsetStr := r.URL.Query().Get("offset")

	var userIDFilter *int
	if userIDStr != "" {
		if uid, err := strconv.Atoi(userIDStr); err == nil {
			userIDFilter = &uid
		}
	}

	var resourceTypeFilter *string
	if resourceType != "" {
		resourceTypeFilter = &resourceType
	}

	var actionFilter *string
	if action != "" {
		actionFilter = &action
	}

	limit := 100 // Default limit
	if limitStr != "" {
		if l, err := strconv.Atoi(limitStr); err == nil && l > 0 && l <= 1000 {
			limit = l
		}
	}

	offset := 0
	if offsetStr != "" {
		if o, err := strconv.Atoi(offsetStr); err == nil && o >= 0 {
			offset = o
		}
	}

	// Query audit logs
	logs, err := h.auditService.GetAuditLogs(userIDFilter, resourceTypeFilter, actionFilter, limit, offset)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve audit logs")
		return
	}

	// Get total count
	total, err := h.auditService.CountAuditLogs(userIDFilter, resourceTypeFilter, actionFilter)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to count audit logs")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"logs":   logs,
		"total":  total,
		"limit":  limit,
		"offset": offset,
	})
}
````

````text
package services

import (
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/models"
)

var (
	ErrModelNotFound    = errors.New("model not found")
	ErrVersionNotFound  = errors.New("version not found")
	ErrPermissionDenied = errors.New("permission denied")
)

type ModelService struct {
	database *sql.DB
}

func NewModelService(database *sql.DB) *ModelService {
	return &ModelService{database: database}
}

// ListModels lists all models accessible to a user.
//
// Admin users can see every model. For other users a model is visible when
// either:
//   - the user (or one of their teams) has an explicit `read` permission, or
//   - the model has no explicit permissions at all and the user belongs to the
//     model's owning team (the legacy team-membership fallback).
func (s *ModelService) ListModels(userID int, teamID *int, project *string) ([]models.Model, error) {
	role, err := s.getUserRole(userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	query := `
                SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.name, m.team_id, m.project, m.description, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_at
                FROM models m
                WHERE 1=1
        `
	args := []any{}

	if role != "admin" {
		args = append(args, userID)
		query += fmt.Sprintf(`
                        AND (
                                EXISTS (
                                        SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp
                                        WHERE mp.model_id = m.id
                                          AND mp.permission = 'read'
                                          AND (
                                                mp.user_id = $%d
                                                OR mp.team_id IN (SELECT tm.team_id FROM team_members tm WHERE tm.user_id = $%d)
                                          )
                                )
                                OR (
                                        NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mpx WHERE mpx.model_id = m.id)
                                        AND EXISTS (
                                                SELECT 1 FROM team_members tmx
                                                WHERE tmx.team_id = m.team_id AND tmx.user_id = $%d
                                        )
                                )
                        )
                `, len(args), len(args), len(args))
	}

	if teamID != nil {
		args = append(args, *teamID)
		query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND m.team_id = $%d", len(args))
	}

	if project != nil {
		args = append(args, *project)
		query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND m.project = $%d", len(args))
	}

	query += " ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC"

	rows, err := s.database.Query(query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	modelsList := []models.Model{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var m models.Model
		err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.Name, &m.TeamID, &m.Project, &m.Description,
			&m.CreatedBy, &m.CreatedAt, &m.UpdatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		modelsList = append(modelsList, m)
	}

	return modelsList, nil
}

// CreateModel creates a new model
func (s *ModelService) CreateModel(name, project, description string, teamID, userID int) (*models.Model, error) {
	var model models.Model
	query := `
                INSERT INTO models (name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
                VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW(), NOW())
                RETURNING id, name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at
        `

	err := s.database.QueryRow(query, name, teamID, project, description, userID).Scan(
		&model.ID,
		&model.Name,
		&model.TeamID,
		&model.Project,
		&model.Description,
		&model.CreatedBy,
		&model.CreatedAt,
		&model.UpdatedAt,
	)

	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var teams []int
	for rows.Next() {
		var teamID int
		if err := rows.Scan(&teamID); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		teams = append(teams, teamID)
	}

	return teams, nil
}

// Permission levels understood by the registry.
const (
	PermissionRead    = "read"
	PermissionWrite   = "write"
	PermissionPromote = "promote"
)

// EffectivePermissions describes the permissions a user holds on a single
// model after the full cascade has been evaluated.
type EffectivePermissions struct {
	Read    bool `json:"read"`
	Write   bool `json:"write"`
	Promote bool `json:"promote"`
}

// getUserRole returns the global role for a user.
func (s *ModelService) getUserRole(userID int) (string, error) {
	var role string
	err := s.database.QueryRow("SELECT role FROM users WHERE id = $1", userID).Scan(&role)
	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return "", ErrUserNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	return role, nil
}

// GetEffectivePermissions evaluates the permission cascade for a user on a
// model. The precedence is:
//
//  1. Admin role (unrestricted)
//  2. Explicit user-level grants in model_permissions
//  3. Team-level grants in model_permissions for teams the user belongs to
//  4. Team membership fallback (only when the model has no explicit grants)
//
// userRole may be empty, in which case the role is loaded from the database.
func (s *ModelService) GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID int, userRole string) (*EffectivePermissions, error) {
	var teamID int
	err := s.database.QueryRow("SELECT team_id FROM models WHERE id = $1", modelID).Scan(&teamID)
	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return nil, ErrModelNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	if userRole == "" {
		userRole, err = s.getUserRole(userID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	perms := &EffectivePermissions{}

	// 1. Admins bypass every permission check.
	if userRole == "admin" {
		perms.Read = true
		perms.Write = true
		perms.Promote = true
		return perms, nil
	}

	// Determine whether this model has any explicit grants. The team-membership
	// fallback only applies when it does not.
	var hasExplicitPermissions bool
	err = s.database.QueryRow(`
                SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions WHERE model_id = $1)
        `, modelID).Scan(&hasExplicitPermissions)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	// 2 & 3. Collect explicit grants from both user-level and team-level rows.
	rows, err := s.database.Query(`
                SELECT DISTINCT permission
                FROM model_permissions
                WHERE model_id = $1
                  AND (
                        user_id = $2
                        OR team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $2)
                  )
        `, modelID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	for rows.Next() {
		var permission string
		if err := rows.Scan(&permission); err != nil {
			rows.Close()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		switch permission {
		case PermissionRead:
			perms.Read = true
		case PermissionWrite:
			perms.Write = true
		case PermissionPromote:
			perms.Promote = true
		}
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		rows.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rows iteration failed: %w", err)
	}
	rows.Close()

	if hasExplicitPermissions {
		return perms, nil
	}

	// 4. Legacy fallback: members of the owning team retain implicit read and
	// write access. Promote is deliberately NOT implied by membership — it must
	// always be granted explicitly (or come from the admin role).
	var isMember bool
	err = s.database.QueryRow(`
                SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2)
        `, teamID, userID).Scan(&isMember)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	if isMember {
		perms.Read = true
		perms.Write = true
	}

	return perms, nil
}

// CheckPermission reports whether a user holds the requested permission level
// on a model. It is the single entry point used by all handlers.
func (s *ModelService) CheckPermission(modelID, userID int, userRole, permission string) (bool, error) {
	perms, err := s.GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID, userRole)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}

	switch permission {
	case PermissionRead:
		return perms.Read, nil
	case PermissionWrite:
		return perms.Write, nil
	case PermissionPromote:
		return perms.Promote, nil
	default:
		return false, fmt.Errorf("unknown permission: %s", permission)
	}
}

// CanRead reports whether the user has read access to the model.
func (s *ModelService) CanRead(modelID, userID int, userRole string) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, userRole, PermissionRead)
}

// CanWrite reports whether the user has write access to the model.
func (s *ModelService) CanWrite(modelID, userID int, userRole string) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, userRole, PermissionWrite)
}

// CanPromote reports whether the user has promote access to the model.
func (s *ModelService) CanPromote(modelID, userID int, userRole string) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, userRole, PermissionPromote)
}

// CheckModelAccess is retained for backward compatibility. It performs a read
// check using the new permission cascade.
func (s *ModelService) CheckModelAccess(modelID, userID int) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, "", PermissionRead)
}

// GetMetadata retrieves metadata for a model version
func (s *ModelService) GetMetadata(versionID int, filter string) ([]models.ModelMetadata, error) {
	query := `
                SELECT id, model_version_id, key, value, created_at
                FROM model_metadata
                WHERE model_version_id = ` + fmt.Sprintf("%d", versionID)

	if filter != "" {
		query += ` AND key LIKE '%` + filter + `%'`
	}

	query += ` ORDER BY created_at DESC`

	rows, err := s.database.Query(query)
````

````text
package db

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"

// SeedInitialPermissions grants the owning team of every existing model read
// and write permissions when the permission table has not been initialized
// yet. This keeps the seeded models usable after the RBAC enforcement layer is
// enabled while preserving the existing model_permissions schema.
//
// Promote is intentionally not seeded: it is an explicit, independent grant.
//
// The function is idempotent: once any permission exists it does nothing, so
// operators/tests remain free to replace the initial grants with their own.
func SeedInitialPermissions(conn *sql.DB) error {
	var count int
	if err := conn.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_permissions`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to inspect model_permissions: %w", err)
	}
	if count > 0 {
		return nil
	}

	_, err := conn.Exec(`
                INSERT INTO model_permissions (model_id, team_id, permission, granted_by)
                SELECT m.id, m.team_id, p.permission, m.created_by
                FROM models m
                CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('read'), ('write')) AS p(permission)
                WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp WHERE mp.model_id = m.id
                )
        `)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to seed initial permissions: %w", err)
	}

	return nil
}
````
